narrative.northStar: The Practice Notebook with a Seal
narrative.overview: Every screen is a page from a Chinese practice notebook: white paper cards on a pale desk, the 米字格 grid behind each character, one red seal that signs the work. Friendly and focused: playful touches on home and setup, quiet one-screen practice inside a session.
keyCharacteristics: Paper cards on a pale desk
One red for action and identity
Tone colours always paired with marks
One phone screen per practice step

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: Seal Red marks the single next action; skip and alternatives are ghost; selections are outlined and checked, never filled red.

rules.name: The Never-Only-Colour Rule
rules.body: Tone colour is always paired with tone marks and contour glyphs; Know/Still learning carry ✓/✗ and a word.

rules.name: The Written-Not-Typeset Rule
rules.body: All Chinese uses ZiYou Kai so characters match their stroke order.

dos: Keep each practice step on one phone screen; swap feedback in place.
Keep sessions to 15-item rounds with an end screen.
Use ZiYou Kai and lang=zh-Hans for Chinese.
donts: Don't fill a selected option with red or make skip the red primary.
Don't put a kicker above a page heading.
Don't use emoji as icons in practice UI.
Don't imply MUNI endorsement, invent testimonials or mention price.
